stories.title: More than half of Victorian lawyers use AI – but only a quarter have cut client fees as a result
stories.summary: Research found that 55% of Victorian lawyers use AI in their legal practices, up from 37% the previous year. Only a quarter have reduced client fees as a result, while reported efficiency gains have fallen short of expectations.

Their Guardian opinion piece says Australian workers expect government protection from AI-related harms and contends that a clear reform option is available.
